tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background, and the ground every text pairing below is checked on.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `background`, `card` and `popover` (17:1 light, 17–19:1 dark).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, dashboard widgets, form sets.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, select lists, popovers and the command palette.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The main action: default buttons, the selected tab's indicator, checked checkboxes and switches. Near-black in light, near-white in dark: the admin has no brand hue.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` (14:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons and quiet fills.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `secondary` (5.9:1 light, 14:1 dark).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Subtle fills: table header rows, inactive tab lists, skeletons.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Placeholders, hints and metadata on `background`, `card` or `muted` (4.6:1 light, 6–8:1 dark). Mist-500, one point darker so it also holds 4.5:1 on `muted`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and highlighted rows in menus, lists and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `accent` (6.6:1 light, 14:1 dark).

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Danger: delete buttons, error text and invalid field rings (4.8:1 on `background` light, 6.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Positive status: published, saved, a positive trend (4.9:1 on `background` light, 11:1 dark). Pair with a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution status: drafts, pending changes (5.1:1 on `background` light, 11:1 dark). Pair with a word.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card and table borders, separators.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and textareas.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus rings (3px, solid) and the border of focused and hovered controls: 4.6:1 on `background` light, 4.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Charts, lightest step.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Charts, second step.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Charts, third step.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Charts, fourth step.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Charts, darkest step.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: The main menu's background.

tokens.name: sidebar-foreground
tokens.usage: Menu text on `sidebar`.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: The active menu item: `primary`'s values, so the main menu stays in the mist family in both themes.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-primary`.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Hovered menu items.

tokens.name: sidebar-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `sidebar-accent`.

tokens.name: sidebar-border
tokens.usage: Lines inside the main menu.

tokens.name: sidebar-ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside the main menu, as `ring`.

tokens.name: color-gray-50
tokens.usage: Mist scale. Lightest mist: the menu background in light. The semantic tokens above use these values; prefer them over the scale.

tokens.name: color-gray-100
tokens.usage: Mist scale. Hover fills in light. The semantic tokens above use these values; prefer them over the scale.

tokens.name: color-gray-200
tokens.usage: Mist scale. Borders and inputs in light. The semantic tokens above use these values; prefer them over the scale.

tokens.name: color-gray-300
tokens.usage: Mist scale. Chart step. The semantic tokens above use these values; prefer them over the scale.

tokens.name: color-gray-400
tokens.usage: Mist scale. Muted text in light. The semantic tokens above use these values; prefer them over the scale.

tokens.name: color-gray-500
tokens.usage: Mist scale. Accent text in light. The semantic tokens above use these values; prefer them over the scale.

tokens.name: color-gray-600
tokens.usage: Mist scale. Secondary text in light. The semantic tokens above use these values; prefer them over the scale.

tokens.name: color-gray-700
tokens.usage: Mist scale. Chart step. The semantic tokens above use these values; prefer them over the scale.

tokens.name: color-gray-800
tokens.usage: Mist scale. Primary in light; muted fills in dark. The semantic tokens above use these values; prefer them over the scale.

tokens.name: color-gray-900
tokens.usage: Mist scale. Text in light; cards in dark. The semantic tokens above use these values; prefer them over the scale.

tokens.name: color-gray-950
tokens.usage: Mist scale. The darkest mist: the page background in dark. The semantic tokens above use these values; prefer them over the scale.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: One family. Body text is 13px; line height 1.5 throughout.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Tailwind `text-xs`: metadata, badges, activity log entries, small buttons.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Tailwind `text-sm`, the body default: form fields, tables, buttons (at weight 500), menus.

styles.name: body-large
styles.usage: Tailwind `text-base`: the edit page header and main menu labels.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Tailwind `text-md`: available, not used in the admin today.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Tailwind `text-xl`: page and form set titles.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Tailwind `text-3xl`: the dashboard greeting and statistic values.

styles.name: display-large
styles.usage: Tailwind `text-4xl`: available, not used in the admin today.

spacing.note: Tailwind's 4px scale: a step n is n × 4px. The admin mostly uses the steps below.

tokens.name: spacing
tokens.usage: The base unit (4px) every Tailwind spacing step multiplies.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: `gap-1`, `p-1`: icon-to-label gaps, tight lists.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: `gap-1.5`, `py-1.5`: menu items, compact rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: `gap-2`, `px-2`, `py-2`: the most used gap, between controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: `px-3`, `p-3`: button and input padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: `p-4`, `gap-4`: card padding, form rows.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: `py-6`: section padding in cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: The base radius (10px). The other radii are fixed multiples of it.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls, checkboxes, badges (0.8 × base).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs and menus (= base).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards and dialogs (1.2 × base).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large cards (1.4 × base).

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Panels (1.8 × base).

tokens.name: radius-3xl
tokens.usage: 2.2 × base.

tokens.name: radius-4xl
tokens.usage: 2.6 × base.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons, checkboxes, switches and toggles: the faintest lift.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and small raised controls.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Cards and popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, selects and toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets.
